2.200.18
RadialPointer.Type
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.Type element specifies the type of a RadialPointer. This element is optional. If this
element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that
evaluates to a String. The value of this element MUST be one of the following or an expression that
evaluates to one of the following:
Needle: Specifies that the radial pointer is a needle.
Marker: Specifies that the radial pointer is a marker.
Bar: Specifies that the radial pointer is a bar.
If the RadialPointer.Type element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Needle".
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.Type element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.Type element.
 <xsd:element name="Type" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0">
